summary: The agent ran the full six-task plan with hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development. Each task got an implementer subagent and a reviewer subagent. It ran both soak tests itself (240 s and 720 s), dispatched the final whole-branch review, ran `sdd-state finish` (which published a receipt), and fast-forward merged into main after I answered "merge back to main locally". It never stopped mid-plan without asking a question, so I never sent "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria are met, and I checked them against the session log (d9e6b71b-….jsonl), git state and file hashes. The agent paused only to ask questions: the workspace question, the window and decision-notes questions, and the finish-option question. Each time I answered from the allowed list. There were no "neither" stops and no BLOCKED.

observations.description: Onboarding: on both the workspace-trust prompt and the bypass-permissions prompt, the highlighted default is 'No, exit'. Pressing Enter by habit would quit.

At startup a 'Newer Opus model available' dialog said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose 'No', and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5'. The dialog seems not to account for the --model flag.

Before dispatching any work, the agent asked whether to move design.md into a subdirectory so its decision-notes compiler would work. That is an internal tooling limitation surfaced as a user question, and it isn't covered by the plan.
Four commits (24ad803, 051ca79, a672889, 54a6bc3) have the 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5' trailer in the subject line instead of the body. The agent noticed this itself in its final summary.
After the merge, __pycache__/ folders are left untracked and there is no .gitignore. The agent flagged this but did not fix it.
The Codex review gate was skipped because the plugin isn't installed. It was logged as a degraded gate for every task and for the final review.

The spinner label 'Pouncing…' stayed the same for about 29 minutes. Status messages between tasks such as 'Tasks 1 to 3 are done and reviewed…' were useful. During the soak runs the screen showed only a long 'Running W=…' command preview.
No test checks the value of DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS, and plan.md still says 1.5 in Task 5. The agent reported both points honestly.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the subagent-driven-development skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use #1: 'Skill hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development'. The first implementer, 'Agent Implement Task 1: package and clocks', is tool_use #21. The screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.

criteria.criterion: All tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: The log has 'sdd-state complete plan.md 1..6', then 'Agent Final whole-branch review', then 'sdd-state finish plan.md', which returned 'status=finished … receipt=…/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261105T192750Z'. `git log --oneline main` shows 6 feature commits (24ad803 … 54a6bc3) on top of e43b065, and the main checkout is at 54a6bc3 [main]. The ratelimit-plan branch was deleted after the fast-forward merge.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not modify tests/test_soak_short.py or tests/test_soak_long.py
criteria.evidence: shasum before and after is the same: 5cd08cd9… test_soak_long.py and 5b4fdfd0… test_soak_short.py. `git diff e43b065 main --stat -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py` printed nothing.

(Stop 1 was the AskUserQuestion workspace prompt 'Where should the plan's work happen? The repo is a normal checkout on main.', answered 'use whatever the skill recommends'. Stop 2 was a two-question dialog. The prose just before it ended '…please choose a window value and whether to relocate the spec (or skip decision notes).' I answered the DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS question with the Task 1 answer and the decision-notes question with 'go ahead with what the plan says'. Stop 3 came after the finish receipt was reported but before the merge, and I answered 'merge back to main locally'. 'continue' was never sent.)
